newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 2.252 billion yuan from 3.436 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.

Traders said trading was less active than on Tuesday with the head offices of some state-run banks staying on the sidelines on renewed market rumours that the central bank would shortly cut bank reserve ratios.
The rumours said the central bank would cut the ratio to 10 percent from the present 13 percent due to sharply falling inflation in the first four months of this year, traders said.
Traders said they expected the interbank rates to move in a narrow range with turnover around the current level in the next few days. -- Shanghai newsroom (86-21) 6279-7004
